objective: Implement, validate, evidence, and complete the governed Google Play mobile, Apple App Store, Google Play Android TV, Cloudflare public-domain, production-backend, CI, physical-device, approval, and submission work until every original AFRICLUB task is proved complete against one exact release candidate.
invariants: The governed denominator remains 87; nested workstreams do not replace or silently close an original task.
A release candidate is exact only when the live checkout is clean, its HEAD is verified on origin/main, and the retained CI run is for that same HEAD.

A stale preflight, prior commit artifact, local build, emulator run, or simulator run is historical evidence only and cannot close an exact-candidate, physical-device, store, deployment, or approval gate.
Every signed artifact must record source_git_head, package or bundle identity, version or build, SHA-256, byte size, signing fingerprint, toolchain, and validation result.
Google Play, App Store Connect, Android TV, Cloudflare, backend, device, and accountable approval results require current remote receipts or current physical evidence.
No credential, key, password, identity-verification material, biometric material, or one-time code may be committed or copied into the goal records.
Completion requires requirement-by-requirement proof; passing local tests or absence of a detected failure is not completion.
